description: An iterative workflow where a writer drafts content and a reviewer provides feedback until the content is approved or max iterations are reached.

nodes.description: Accepts content requirements from the user
Initializes the review loop state with requirements and settings
Generates or revises content based on requirements and feedback

config.system_prompt: You are an expert content writer. Your task is to create or revise content based on the provided requirements and any feedback from previous reviews. Produce high-quality, well-structured content.

nodes.description: Evaluates content quality and provides structured feedback

config.system_prompt: You are a critical content reviewer. Evaluate the provided content against the requirements. Provide specific feedback including: 1) Overall quality score (0-100), 2) Decision: APPROVED or NEEDS_REVISION, 3) Detailed comments, 4) Specific suggestions for improvement.

nodes.description: Decides whether to continue the loop or finalize

config.code: if feedback.decision == 'APPROVED' or state.iteration_count >= state.max_iterations - 1: decision = {'action': 'finalize'} else: decision = {'action': 'revise'}

nodes.description: Updates state with new draft and feedback, increments counter

config.code: state.current_draft = draft; state.feedback_history.append(feedback); state.iteration_count += 1; updated_state = state

nodes.description: Routes to either continue loop or finalize based on decision
Finalizes the output and marks workflow complete

config.code: state.is_complete = True; state.final_output = state.current_draft.content; final_output = state

nodes.description: Returns the final approved content and review history

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of review cycles before forcing finalization

approval_threshold.description: Quality score threshold (0-100) for automatic approval

final_content.description: The final approved or last revised content

approved.description: Whether the content was approved or max iterations reached

feedback_history.description: History of all reviews and feedback
